paragraphs: LexisNexis Risk Solutions sells information-based analytics, decisioning tools and data management services that customers use to reduce risk and improve operations. The company is headquartered in metro-Atlanta, Georgia, and operates within the Risk market segment of RELX. Its pages describe detecting fraud and money laundering, and delivering actionable insights to insurance companies and healthcare networks.

The about page states that the company works with more than 8,000 federal, state, and local government and law enforcement agencies. The same page also counts business with 85% of the Fortune 500 and 90% of the Fortune 100. Insurance buyers listed there include 23 of the world's top 25 insurers. Healthcare buyers listed there include 150 U.S. commercial payers and over 50% of the top 100 U.S. health systems.

quote.text: We believe in the power of data and analytics to manage risk & uncover opportunity.
